entities.summary: Graeme Reid, also known as Graham Reid, is a retired field hockey player from Australia. He was a member of the national team that won the silver medal at the 1976 Summer Olympics in Montreal, Quebec, Canada. He also represented Australia at the 1972 Summer Olympics in Munich, Germany. Graeme Reid was a athletes & competitors from Australia (b. 1948-06-15). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
